tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gcod kyi gdams ngag thar 'dod kyi skyes bu'i theg pa mchog gi lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /gcod kyi gdams ngag thar 'dod kyi skyes bu'i theg pa mchog gi lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod kyi gdams ngag thar 'dod kyi skyes bu'i theg pa mchog gi lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /gang de'i rnam 'phrul grub pa'i dbang*/ /ma gcig labs kyi sgron ma la/ /btud nas gcod kyi gdams ngag bri/ /'di la spy-ir bla ma sngon ma dag gis mdzad pa mang zhing/ khyad par du paṇa chen gong mas mdzad pa'i rgyas bsdus gnyis dang*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gcod kyi gdams pa'i snying po rtsa tshig lta bu zhig snang ba las/ 'dir de gnyis kyi snying po bsdus pa'i 'bring po zhig bshad par bya'o/ /brgyud pa la ring brgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ thub dbang byams 'jam dbyangs sogs mang du 'byung la/ nye brgyud ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /nyams len dngos gzhi la gzugs sku'i rgyu tshogs bsags pa dang*/ chos sku'i rgyu stong nyid sgom tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ mchod yul bskyed cing yan lag bdun pa byas te nang gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ sems can thams cad pha mar bsgoms nas sha khrag sbyin pa dang*/ yi dam dang bla ma bsgoms nas bdud rtsis mchod de dngos grub blang ba'o/ /dang po la sngon du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med rnams spyi ltar ram/ /bsdu na/ ༈ /bla ma mchog gsum yi dam dang*/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro bstan srung la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /phaṭaḥ rang gi spy-i bor sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i ma gcig labs kyi sgron ma de nyid rnam pa rdo rjai phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'od 'phro ba'i dbus na/

zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i spy-i bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang bar hā ljang khu/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros mkha' spyod kyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje phag mo la bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs/ phaṭaḥ chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /'khor bcas brtser dgongs gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ai h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ gnod byed kyis gtsos pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'gug bcing bsdams shing dbang du byas nas rang gi mthar 'khod par gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa steng gang bar smug shig ger gnas par gyur/ de nas rang nyid kyi gtso byas te thams cad mgrin gcig tu skyabs gnas la yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar bsams la/ ngag tu/ phaṭaḥ lhun grub spros dang bral ba'i chos dbyings dang*/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rol ba las/ /sna tshogs du mar sprul pa'i ḍā ki ma/ /bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal/ /bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i klong yangs nas/ /zag med bde chen bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /phun tshogs rnam 'gyur stong gi rol pa can/ /ma lus khyed rnams dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung nyes tshogs kun/ /rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang du so sor bshags/ /rang gzhan kun gyis bskun pa'i rnam dkar la/ /bsam pa thag pas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /'gro kun don du bskal pa ji srid bar/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor

zhing*/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum rnam dkar legs tshogs ci bgyis pa/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'chang dbang thob phyir bsngo/ /bslu med skyabs gnas khyed rnams thams cad kyis/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ /de ltar gsol bas bcom ldan 'das ma yi/ /sku yi cha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /rang gzhan kun gyi lus kyi char zhugs te/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon mi shes kun sbyangs nas/ /lus ni shel gong bzhin du dag par gyur/ /de nas bem rig phral ba ni/ rang gi lus kyi nang dbus rtsa dbu ma/ /kha dog dmar po yar sna spyi bor zug /spyi gtsug rgya mthong kha ltar thal ler gsal/ /mar sna ste 'og zug pa'i lte ba yi/ rtsa 'khor dbus su rang gi rnam shes ni/ /thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ /'phar zhing 'phur la khad pa zhig tu gyur/ phaṭaḥ rnam shes theg le gyen song snying mgrin dang*/ /spy-i bor sleb pa hrig hrig gnas par 'gyur/ /phaṭaḥ slar yang rnam shes thig le gyen song nas/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kar thim gyur pas/ bem po'i lus de sa la ling gis 'gyel/ /bem rig so sor phral te gnas par gyur/ /de nas nang gi maṇ+ḍal ni/ phaṭaḥ bla ma rdo rje phag mo'i thugs ka nas/ /rang gi rnam shes de nyid mkha' 'gro ma/ /gri thod 'dzin pa'i rnam par rgyangs kyis byung*/ /phaṭaḥ bem po'i lus kyi spyi bo nas bzung ste/ /brla rtsa'i bar du gri gug 'bar bas gshags/ /phaṭaḥ snying ga nas bzung g.yas g.yon lag rtse dang*/ /sum phrag nas bzung g.yas g.yon rkang rtse'i bar/ /gshags shing lpags pa sbud bshus dmar chal bkram/ /de nas nang gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ phaṭaḥ lpags pa sa gzhir khrag gis chag chag btab/ /sha khrag rus gsum me tog tshon bu dang*/ /yan lag gling bzhi nying lag gling phran dbus/ /khog pa sgal tshigs sa 'dzin brtsegs pa'i rtser/ /mgo bo rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang*/

/mig gnyis nyi zla snying ni yid bzhin nor/ /nang khrol rnams las lha mi'i phun tshogs gyur/ /phaṭaḥ 'dod rgu'i rgya mtsho nang gi maṇ+ḍal 'di/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dba' bo mkha' 'gro ma/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ /'bul bgyi bzhes nas byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod cing 'bul/ nyes pa la sngon du sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul mtshon tsam ni/ kye ma gdon bgegs lan chags sogs/ /sngon nas pha mar gyur pa yi/ /rigs drug 'gro ba'i don du ni/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /de phyir drin du che nges pa'i/ /mar gyur rigs drug 'gro rnams kun/ /ngan song 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /thar bar gyur cig thar bar bya/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun/ /bdag gi steng shog bdag nyid kyi/ /bde dge thams cad gzhan la sbyin/ /gzhan rnams bde dang ldan gyur cig /'dre gdon la sogs rigs drug 'gro /thams cad ris med gtan gyi bde/ /bla med byang chub go 'phang la/ /bdag gis myur du dgod par bya/ /de slad bla ma yi dam lhas/ /bdag la byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ /de nas nye brgyud kyi gsol 'debs dang byin rlabs rgyu mtshan ni/ ༈ phaṭaḥ rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags/ /de sras 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang*/ /mkhas mchog chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba=/ grub mchog chos kyi rdo rje dang*/ /blo bzang don grub paṇa chen rje/ /chos 'di'i dngos brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba=/ mdor na bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo labs sgron sogs/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro thams cad la=/ gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/

/rang nyid gces 'dzin 'dor ba dang*/ /gzhan dag gces par 'dzin pa yi/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /legs par 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod nus pa'i/ /bdag med gnas lugs rtogs pa dang*/ /chos gzugs sku gnyis bde blag tu/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas sha khrag sbyin pa ni/ 'dir cung zad rgyas par na/ de ltar gsol bas bcom ldan 'das ma yi/ /zhes pa nas/ lpags pa spud bshus dmar chal bkram/ /zhes pa'i bar bya zhing*/ bsdu na sngon ma'i rgyun yod par mos te ma byas kyang mi 'gal bar sems/ gang ltar yang ngag tu/ phaṭaḥ klad pa khu ba dwangs ma rnams/ /'dod yon mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba ni/ phaṭaḥ zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /mchog gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /bstan srung tshogs dang bcas la 'bul/ /brtse bas bzhes la mchog thun gyi/ /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /tshigs ma sha khrag rus tshogs kyis/ /sa steng khyab cing gang bar gyur/ /de nas slar yang*/ rang gi rnam shes mkha' 'gro mas/ /gri gug g.yob cing 'di skad du/ /phaṭaḥ srid rtse nas bzung mnar med par/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang*/ /gdon bgegs ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'di ru tshogs shing 'dir 'dus shig /nga yi sgyu ma'i phung po 'di/ /pha ma 'dre gdon la sogs pa'i/ /rigs drug 'gro ba'i glud du 'bul/ /bla ma dam pa'i glud du 'bul/ /dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron la mchod/ /mgon po yon tan mgron la 'bul/ /rigs drug snying rje'i 'gro la gtong*/ /lan chags mgron la bu lon 'jal/ /phaṭaḥ khyed rnams las ni mgron gang zhig /sha khrag rus pa nang khrol dang*/ /tshe srog bkrag mdangs la sogs pa/ /gang la dga' ba de khyer shig /zo zhig 'thung zhig ci dgar gyis/ /phaṭaḥ

lpags pa dum bur btubs pa rnams/ /'dod rgu 'byung ba'i dngos por gyur/ /phaṭaḥ rang rang ci ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /phun tshogs dngos po rnams khyer la/ /nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi sogs/ /gang du dga' ba'i gnas su song*/ /phaṭaḥ dmigs med sgom pa ni/ gang gis sbyin dang gang la sbyin/ /sbyin bya'i dngos po la sogs pa/ /'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyang*/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ /stong dang rten 'brel zung 'jug pa'i/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /tha snyad bya byed 'thad pa yi/ /dge bas sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /'di dag ni dmar 'gyed du grags pa de yin la/ gsum pa ni dkar 'gyed du grags pa ste sngon ma dang 'di gnyis la go rim nges pa can mi snang ngo*/ /'di gnyis so sor nyams su blangs kyang mi 'gal zhing*/ dkyus gcig la nyams su len pa mang la/ so sor byed na ni skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang ste/ yul bskyed pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs pad zla'i steng*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid dang dbyer med pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ma gcig labs kyi sgron/ /de nyid rnam pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /phyag g.yas seng ldeng ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ /g.yon pa dngul dkar dril bu drag tu gsil/ /dar dkar dbu skra phyed bcings lhag ma 'phyang*/ /'dzum sgeg nyams ldan lha rdzas na bza' gsol/ /nyi ma stong gi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i dbus/ /zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums gar stabs bzhugs/ /de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ /de nas yi dam dang bla mar bsgoms nas mchod cing dngos grub zhu ba la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de ltar gsol bas bcom ldan 'das ma yi/ /sku yi cha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /zhes pa nas/ bo mo rag so phral te gnas pa yi/ /thugs ka'i gnas nas bdag gi rnam par shes/

/rnam pa ye shes mkha' 'gro gri thod 'dzin/ /rgyangs kyis thon nas nam mkhar 'khod par gyur/ /snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang nyid dang*/ /bcud kyi sems can 'dre gdon la sogs pa'i/ /rigs drug thams cad lha dang lha mor gyur/ /rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma mkha' 'gro dang*/ /rigs drug lhar gyur kun gyi thugs ka nas/ /'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas bla ma dang*/ /mkha' 'gro dbyer med rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /lhan cig spyan drangs rang dang rigs drug kun/ /lhar gsal rnams la thim pas dbyer med gyur/ /de nas bdud rtsis mchod pa ni 'di ltar/ ༈ /rang gi phung po dkar zhing che la snum/ /tsho ba'i mdun du yaṃ las rlung dkyil steng*/ /raṃ las me dkyil de steng āḥlas ni/ /mi mgo'i sgyed bu chen po gsum du gyur/ /rang gi rnam shes mkha' 'gro gri thod can/ /gri gug phung po rnying ba'i sman phrag tu/ /btsugs te thod pa ling gis bkog byas nas/ /mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng bzhag pas/ /rgya ni stong gsum khyon dang mnyam gyur nang*/ /phung po de bcug gri gug rab 'bar bas/ /dum bur gtubs pa'i 'og gi rlung g.yos te/ /me sbar rdzas rnams zhu ba'i rlangs pa yis/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs ka nas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi rnams bkug thod pa'i nang*/ /babs pas nyes pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs te/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ mgron rnams kun gyi ljags nyid rdo rje yi/ /'od zer sbu gus drangs te gsol bar gyur/ /oṃ gu ru sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wa ra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rigs drug mgron/ /lhar gsal ma lus kun nas tshim gyur nas/ /thugs rgyud zag med bde bas dgyes gyur cig /bde stong dbyer med ye shes skye gyur cig /dngos grub zhu ba ni/ de ltar gsol bas kun gyi gnas lnga las/

/bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung rang gi gnas lnga ru/ /thim pas lus kyi gnas lnga byin brlabs pas/ /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gyur/ /ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa bla ma bsgoms nas dngos grub zhu tshul paṇa chen gyi der shin tu bsdus shing*/ 'dir cung zad bsdu na/ mchod yul bskyed pa ni/ rang nyid mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu/ /'dre gdon gnod byed rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ / dbyer med bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor sems can kun/ /dngos brgyud bla ma gzhan gyi rnam par gyur/ /de dag sgo gsum rdo rje gsum mtshan pa'i/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas mchog nas/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas zhi khro'i tshogs/ /spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur/ /yan lag bdun pa sogs ni/ /skyabs gnas rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung so sor bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rtag par bzhugs gsol dge ba ci mchis pa/ /bla med byang chub go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /gling bzhi gling phran ri rab nyi zla dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas te 'bul/ /phyi nang bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub thams cad stsol phyir 'bul/ /dngos grub blang ba ni/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro rgyal ba zhi khro la/ /gus pas gsol ba 'debs so brtser dgongs nas/ /bdag la dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ /sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar gsol bas bla ma mkha' 'gro yi/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum las bdud rtsi dang*/ /'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang*/ /cig car byung nas rang gi gnas gsum du/ /rim dang cig car thim pas sgrib bzhi dang*/ /dbang bzhi thob cing sku bzhi'i nus pa bzhag /'khor rnams gtso bor thim zhing gtso mo nyid/ /rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /chos rnams gdod nas rang bzhin gyis dben yang*/

/sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam dkar dge tshogs rnams/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun gyi don ched du/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /gnyis pa chos sku'i rgyu stong nyid sgom pa ni/ 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad rang rang gi /cha shas dag la brten nas btags shing bzhag / brten nas 'byung ba'i chos rnams gang yin pa/ /de dag rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis stong*/ /stong pa rang bzhin med pa'i ngo bo dang*/ /snang ba rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu gnyis/ /gzhi gcig la ni 'gal med 'du ba yi/ /snang stong tshogs pa'i zung 'jug e ma mtshar/ /snod bcud snang ba thams cad lhan cig tu/ / 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ /dmigs med mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams len las/ /mi 'da'i tshul gyis rnam par rol bar gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu ris med 'gro rnams la/ /gcig tu brtse ba'i snying rje chen po dang*/ /byams dang lhag bsam sems bskyed skye 'phel thabs/ lam mchog 'di dang mi 'bral nyams len shog /de yi mthu las theg mchog lam bzang gis/ /rang rgyud smin cing grol ba'i skal ldan cing*/ /chos gzugs 'grub pa'i rgyu tshogs myur rdzogs nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /ces sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ /'di thams cad dkyus gcig la nyams su len pa'am/ ma grub na rang gang 'dod pa de tsam du nyams su blang yang rung ngo*/ /bsdus pa ni paṇa chen rin po che'i gsungs ltar bkod na/ skyabs sems sogs byas te/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /dbyer med rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin/ /mchan khung kha ṭaṃ ga yis mdzes par brgyan/ khro chags spyan gsum mche ba cung zad gtsigs/ /skra grol gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol/ / brkyangs bskums gar gyis pad nyi ro gdan bzhugs/

/ rang lus dbus su dbu ma mda' smyug tsam/ /spyi bo nas bzung spyi gtsug thal ler zug /snying dbus dhū tīr rang sems thig le'i gzugs/ /dkar 'tsher 'od kyi phung po rgya sran tsam/ phaṭaḥ snying ga nas thon skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor ma yi thugs kar thim/ /rang lus bem po shing sdong bcad pa bzhin/ /ling gis 'gyel bas stong gsum khyon gang zhing*/ / dkar zhing che la snum zhing mdzes par gyur/ /slar yang rang sems bla ma'i thugs ka nas/ /mkha' 'gro gri gug 'dzin pa'i rnam par thon/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu ni/ /ri rgyal lhun po lta bu gsum gyi steng*/ /gri gug 'bar bas thod pa bkog nas bkal/ /phung po rnying pa de yi nang bcug ste/ /gri gug gis btubs g.yas skor gsum dkrugs shing*/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gis zag med ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa nyid/ /srid zhi'i mgron rnams mchod cing tshim ste mnyes/ /dmigs med stong pa'i ngang nas dge ba rnams/ / rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa thob phyir bsngo/ /dkar 'gyed do// //༈ yang dmar 'gyed ni/ sngar bzhin bem rig bral ba yan chad byas nas/ 'di ltar/ rang sems gri gug thogs pa'i mkha' 'gro mas/ /phung po rnying pa'i smon mtshams sum khrag dang*/ /rkang lag bzhi rtser rgya gram bshags byas te/ /lpags pa bshus nas sa steng dmar chal bkram/ /sha khrag gtor mas srid gsum gang gyur pa/ /dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron la mchod pa 'bul/ /mgon po yon tan mgron la gtang rag gtong*/ /rigs drug snying rje'i mgron la sbyin pa dang*/ /gdon bgegs lan chags mgron la bu lon 'jal/ /rang rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i dam rdzas kyis/ /skye 'phags ma lus mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ /mchod sbyin 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang*/ /chu zla bzhin du snang yang bden pas stong*/ /phaṭaḥ bden med spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i

ngang*/ /dbyings rig dbyer med rtse gcig mnyam gzhag ste/ /rjes thob dge kun byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /yang rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad sdong steng*/ /bla ma labs kyi sgron ma la/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga brgyud pa yi/ /bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog gsum/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams bsam/ /de nas bem rig phral byas shing*/ /dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med dang*/ /rang nyid khros ma nag mor bsgom/ /phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug gis/ /ri rab dang mnyam phung po yi/ /thod pa phral nas mi mgo yi/ /rlon pa'i sgyed bu gsum la bkal/ /de nas sha khrag thams cad blugs/ /oṃ ā hūṃ gis bdud rtsir byas/ /thod pa thogs pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' gang bas rab tu mchod/ /de nas gnod byed gdon bgegs dang*/ /rigs drug kun la rab tu sbyin/ /'khor gsum dmigs pa med par bya/ /rtse gcig chos kyi sku ru bsngo/ /slar yang sngar bzhin bem rig phral/ /dbyings rig bsres nas rnal 'byor mas/ /phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug gis/ /rang gi phung bo kha phye nas/ /sha dang rus pa ri rab tsam/ /khrag ni rgya mtsho chen por mtshungs/ /srid pa'i rtse mo nas bzung ste/ /mnar med dmyal ba yan chad kyi/ /snang srid lha srin thams cad bsdus/ /sha zos khrag 'thung rus pa mur/ /thams cad bdud rtsis tshim par bsam/ /gzhan yang 'dre gdon ma lus pa/ /pha mar bsams la byams brtse bsgom/ /bla mar bsams la mchod pa 'bul/ /yi dam du bsams dngos grub zhu/ /chos skyong du bsams 'phrin las bcol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i slongs tshad dang*/ /tshar tshad tshe gtad ngos zin bya/ /bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang*/ /rang nyid gces 'dzin bcad byas nas/ /chos kun khyad par 'dre gdon sogs/ /yul gyi steng nas rdul tsam yang*/ /grub pa med snyam blo thag bcad/ /dmigs med ngang nas dge ba de/

/kun kyang thun mong byang chub bsngo/ /ces 'byung ba ltar ro/ /smras pa/ /rgyal yum ma gcig labs sgron ma'i/ /chos tshul gcod kyi gdams pa mchog /dam pa'i bzhed srol ji bzhin du/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i ngag gis bsdebs/ /'di yi dbang lung man ngag rgyun/ /rgyal sras rje btsun paṇ+ḍi ta'i/ /drung nas thob kyang lag len du/ /bstar ba'i 'dun pa sngar ma skyes/ /'on kyang bla chen mkhas pa 'gas/ /khyod nyid ma gcig labs sgron gyi/ /ma 'ongs lung bstan de las ni/ /'di ltar zin zhes gsung thos tshe/ /yid la dga' ba'i dad gus zhig /skyes nas drin du gzo ba dang*/ /mchod phyir 'di nyid spel 'dun shar/ /tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i rnam dkar dges/ /skye kun rgyal yum de nyid kyis/ /dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang myur thob shog /ces pa de lta bu'i gdams pa 'di nyid spyir byams snying rje lhag bsam sems bskyed kyi khyad par ci rigs dang ldan cing*/ theg chen la mos pa che ba zhig gis nyams su blangs na khyad che zhing*/ khyad par du tshe 'di blos btang ba'i ri khrod pa 'dre gdon sogs rigs drug gi 'gro ba dman pa rnams la lhag par byams snying rje dang ldan pa dag gis nyams len gyi snying por bya rigs so/ /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i btsun pa grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas dad pa kho nas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅga laṃ/ /zhus dag
